description: A line under the shear x += 0.5y, carried as a three-level INSERT chain. A DWG stores no shear in any single INSERT, but the singular value decomposition of the 2x2 matrix is a rotation, a non-uniform scale and a rotation, so three nested INSERTs reach the same world-space line. The angles and scales are derived values (tools/authoring/chain_svd.py), compared under PVec numeric policy v1 and not exact.
